sentences.text: Today we will talk about the Czech Republic.
It is also called Czechia.
Let's learn about this country in simple English.
I will speak slowly.
You can listen and repeat if you like.
Where is the Czech Republic?
The Czech Republic is in central Europe.
It is in the middle of the continent.
It does not have a sea.
It is a landlocked country.
It is next to Germany, Poland, Austria, and Slovakia.
The Czech Republic is a small country, but it is very beautiful.
What is the capital city of the Czech Republic?
The capital city is Prague.
Prague is also the biggest city in the country.
Many people live in Prague.
It has old buildings, big bridges, and beautiful churches.
Prague is a popular city for tourists.
People come to see the Charles Bridge, the Old Town Square, and the castle.
How many people live in the Czech Republic?
About 10.
5 million people live in the Czech Republic.
Most people live in cities and towns.
Many people live in Prague, Brno, Ostrava, and Polzhen.
What language do people speak in the Czech Republic?
People speak Czech.
Czech is the official language.
It is a Slavic language.
It is not easy to learn, but it is very interesting.
In schools, children learn English.
Some people also speak German or Russian.
What is the weather like in the Czech Republic?
The Czech Republic has four seasons.
Spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
In summer, it is warm.
People go outside and enjoy the sun.
In winter, it is cold.
Sometimes it snows and people wear warm clothes.
Spring and autumn are cool and nice.
There are flowers in spring and colorful leaves in autumn.
What does the Czech Republic look like?
The Czech Republic has hills, rivers, forests, and villages.
There are also mountains in the north and south.
One big river is the Vltava River.
It goes through Prague.
The country also has castles and old towns.
There are many UNESCO World Heritage sites.
People love to walk, hike, and bike in nature.
What animals live in the Czech Republic?
There are many animals in the forests.
You can see deer, foxes, wild boars, and rabbits.
There are also many birds.
In the mountains, you can find lynxes and sometimes wolves.
The nature is clean and quiet.
What do people eat in the Czech Republic?
People in the Czech Republic eat simple and tasty food.
They often eat meat, potatoes, and bread.
One popular food is svičková.
It is beef with sauce and dumplings.
Another dish is goulash, a thick meat stew.
People eat it with dumplings, not with rice.
Soup is also very popular.
Many people eat soup before lunch every day.
A sweet food is kaláče, a type of small cake with fruit or cheese.
People drink tea, coffee, and beer.
The Czech Republic is known for its beer.
What is life like in the Czech Republic?
Life in the Czech Republic is calm.
People go to work or school during the week.
On weekends, they spend time with family.
They go for walks, ride bikes, or visit the countryside.
Cafes and parks are very common.
People like to sit outside and drink coffee or tea.
There are many festivals, music events, and holiday traditions.
At Christmas, people eat fried carp and potato salad.
At Easter, people paint eggs and give small gifts.
Some fun facts about the Czech Republic.
The Czech Republic became independent in 1993.
Before, it was part of Czechoslovakia.
The Czech language uses special letters like sh and g.
The Czech Republic has over 2,000 castles, more than any other country in Europe.
Prague Castle is the largest ancient castle in the world.
The Czech people love books.
They read a lot.
Now you know many things about the Czech Republic.
You know where it is, what language people speak, and what the weather is like.
You know about the cities, food, animals, and culture.
Well done.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I'm Emily.
See you next time.
Goodbye.
Thanks for watching.
